reviews.title: C’était génial, « avant « ….
reviews.text: Bonjour, je suis outré depuis plusieurs semaines car votre application etait de loin là meilleure selon moi. Comment est-ce possible de payer encore pour une application d’organisation et voir ses tâches disparaître, réapparaître, être créé puis disparaître aussitôt…Voir l’application devenir tellement lente qu’elle est quasi inutilisable au quotidien, ce qui est sa fonction première…Les fonctionnalités de base deviennent impossibles, la fonction habitudes est extrêmement dure à cocher et devient inutilisable et j’en passe. Jusqu’ici l’IA n’apporte vraiment pas grand chose et je connais plusieurs personnes qui ont le même problème depuis la même période. Je trouve cela incorrect au possible de ne pas communiquer et de laisser les gens payer pour ça . J’aimerais un geste commercial de votre part et surtout une véritable remise en service des fonctions standards!! Je vais finir par changer d’application alors que c’était une merveille telle qu’elle était.

reviews.title: Don’t Bother, Completely Broken
reviews.text: I signed up and paid for TickTick Pro, only to delete my account after a week of frustration and back and forth with completely unhelpful support. If you want to view all of your tasks for the next 7 days, or even just for tomorrow, forget it! TickTick’s “smart views” (ironic huh!) are completely broken and randomly skip recurring tasks, or just skip days altogether, and support have no idea why or what’s going wrong. They’ll make all sorts of suggestions that have nothing to do with the issue, or view you’re fighting to get working. TickTick is at best a Google Calendar that you have to pay for every month… Even then free Google calendar is better and atleast doesn’t randomly miss important reminders and tasks without rhyme nor reason.

reviews.title: All style and little substance. Glaring interface gaps make this not worth the price
reviews.text: Have been using for about half a year now and while there is a lot to like, the seemingly obvious gaps in interface options are irritating enough to have me looking elsewhere. The inability to choose what time intervals you want your constant reminder in (and the fact that they are not constant) seems almost …insane considering what the point of the app is, if your task can’t be completed in 5 minutes with a very loud alarm going off every 30 seconds good luck. Being able to have an hourly reminder for tasks that may take the whole day feels so obvious and yet they’ve chosen to not offer that despite their user’s requests. Not being able to organize my daily list by newest to oldest… i mean… just why?? Why would i not be able to do that? It feels like they’ve made their product and have zero interest in making sure it is able to help with any kind of diverse task management. Oh also if you have multiple tasks with reminders set at the same time your push notification will just say “3 tasks” instead of what they are… and no option to change that, what gives? All style and no substance sums up my experience with this app
